verdict.rationale: Warp generates AI insights from the user's own terminal data. Users can right-click to have Warp AI explain errors and spot missing dependencies in command output. The agent runs commands and interprets the results, and natural-language '#' prompts return AI command suggestions. MCP connections let the AI pull context from databases, APIs and internal services; a community user praises the AI-generated commands, and another reports Prompt Suggestions and Next Command features working off session data. Missing for 10: a dedicated insights or analysis surface for user data beyond terminal output and errors, and independent hands-on corroboration of how good the insights are.
